name: Hakkan
source:
Hakkan is a bright character and one of the Kannagi no Tori just like Ikaru. Unlike Renjaku, he is outgoing and loves to joke around. He serves as an older brother figure to Ikaru, who he refers to as 'brat' or 'chibi' and always scolds him for not completing his tasks as he's supposed to. He also cares about Ikaru and also wants to make sure Ikaru retrieves the soul of Ruu, as he also doesn't want to see his friend disappear.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kannagi_no_Tori]Wikipedia[/url]]
